name: La Crosse Rail Bridge (Canadian Pacific swing bridge)
source_note: 21.9 ft figure is for the closed span, from a public secondary source. Bridge opens on signal for tow traffic — treat the closed-span figure as a worst case, not the usual clearance. Correction (2026-08-09): operated by Canadian Pacific, not BNSF as originally listed here; also crosses between La Crescent, MN and La Crosse, WI at a notably different spot than the Cass St/Cameron Ave road bridges, not right next to them — earlier coordinates were wrong on this point specifically, not just imprecise. Fixed using the bridge's Wikipedia infobox.
notes: Confirm bridge is open before transiting if air draft exceeds closed-span clearance.

name: Chain of Rocks Canal Bridge (road, over the navigation canal)
source_note: A published figure exists (480.2 ft) but it's an elevation-datum reading referenced to a specific 'Lock 27 (Chain of Rocks) Upper Gage', not a stage-subtraction like the other bridges here, and no matching NWPS/USGS gauge for that exact reference was found. Deliberately left blank rather than risk computing a wrong number from a mismatched datum. One-lane road bridge over the Chain of Rocks Canal (the ~8.4mi bypass channel most tow traffic actually uses past the Chain of Rocks shoal) — distinct from the old Route 66 Chain of Rocks Bridge, which is pedestrian/bike-only and crosses the natural river channel, not the canal. Coordinates fixed (2026-08-09) using a listing giving its position as N 38°45.712' W 090°08.286'; the earlier estimate was off by roughly 3km in longitude.
notes: NEEDS DATA — clearance unknown, do not assume a value. Verify against the current USACE chart book / Lock 27 gauge before using.
